```plato

// A half-line in the plane: starts at Origin and extends along Direction only.
// The point at parameter t >= 0 is Origin + Direction * t.
type Ray2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IConnected, INearestPoint2D
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    Direction: Direction2D;
}
```
